# Free Scripture

> Free Scripture (freescripture.org) explains well-known Bible stories in plain words, one scene at a time, with the Bible verse beside every paragraph. It also has the full Bible in four public-domain translations: the Berean Standard Bible (BSB, the default), the World English Bible (WEB), the King James Version (KJV, with the Apocrypha), and the Bible in Basic English (BBE). It is free, with no ads and no account. It is made by Hope for Americans, a nonprofit in Flagstaff, Arizona, and each story is reviewed by a pastor before it is marked final.

Free Scripture is written for adults who are new to the Bible, who stopped reading it, or who find it hard to read. Stories are retold from the BSB in short sentences. Each paragraph links to the exact verses it retells, so a reader can always check the story against the Bible text. When quoting a story, cite the Bible reference shown on the page.

## Bible stories, explained scene by scene

- [All stories](https://freescripture.org/stories/): 69 stories and teachings, grouped by part of the Bible's big story. Each has a cast list, background, a scene-by-scene retelling with verses, questions to think about, and one line to memorize.
- [David and Goliath](https://freescripture.org/stories/david-and-goliath/): 1 Samuel 17, explained in plain words.
- [The Prodigal Son](https://freescripture.org/stories/the-prodigal-son/): Luke 15, the lost son, the running father, and the older brother.
- [The Woman at the Well](https://freescripture.org/stories/the-woman-at-the-well/): John 4, Jesus and the Samaritan woman.
- [The Crucifixion](https://freescripture.org/stories/the-crucifixion/) and [The Resurrection](https://freescripture.org/stories/the-resurrection/): Good Friday and Easter in the Gospel of Luke.
- [Psalm 23](https://freescripture.org/stories/psalm-23/) and [The Lord's Prayer](https://freescripture.org/stories/the-lords-prayer/): line by line, in plain words.

## Reading paths (several stories in order)

- [Moses and the Exodus](https://freescripture.org/paths/moses-and-the-exodus/): Baby Moses, the burning bush, the ten plagues, the Passover, the Red Sea, the Ten Commandments.
- [The Sermon on the Mount](https://freescripture.org/paths/sermon-on-the-mount/): Matthew 5 to 7 in seven short stories.
- [Holy Week](https://freescripture.org/paths/holy-week/): Palm Sunday to Easter, in order.
- [Christmas](https://freescripture.org/paths/christmas/): the angel visits Mary, the birth of Jesus, the wise men.
- [Miracles of Jesus](https://freescripture.org/paths/miracles-of-jesus/), [Who is Jesus?](https://freescripture.org/paths/who-is-jesus/), [When life feels heavy](https://freescripture.org/paths/when-life-feels-heavy/), [Lost and found](https://freescripture.org/paths/lost-and-found/).

## The parables of Jesus

- [All 37 parables](https://freescripture.org/parables/): each with its Bible text, parallel accounts in other Gospels, and a one-line summary of the turn in the story.

## Bible timeline

- [Bible timeline](https://freescripture.org/timeline/): the whole Bible story in time order, in 4 parts and 11 eras, with key people, places, events, and where each book fits.

## Bible verses for how you feel

- [All topics](https://freescripture.org/read/): short sets of verses for fear, grief, strength, guilt, forgiveness, wisdom, loneliness, a racing mind, doubt, anger, good news, a new baby, gratitude, and thinking of someone. Each is easy to send to a friend.

## The full Bible

- [Berean Standard Bible (BSB)](https://freescripture.org/bsb/): a modern, accurate translation released to the public domain in 2023. The default text, and the base text for every story.
- [World English Bible (WEB)](https://freescripture.org/web/): a public-domain modern English translation.
- [King James Version (KJV)](https://freescripture.org/kjv/): the 1769 revision of the 1611 translation, with the Apocrypha (80 books).
- [Bible in Basic English (BBE)](https://freescripture.org/bbe/): uses about 1,000 common English words. Helpful for English learners.
- [Side by side](https://freescripture.org/compare/): any chapter in two translations at once, or a story next to the Bible text it retells.
- Every chapter has its own page at https://freescripture.org/{translation}/{book}/{chapter}/ , for example https://freescripture.org/bsb/john/3/ .

## Other

- [Memorize](https://freescripture.org/memorize/): learn one Bible line at a time.
- [Search](https://freescripture.org/search/): find a story by the name you know ("Jonah and the whale", "feeding the 5,000") or a verse like John 3:16.
- [About and method](https://freescripture.org/about/): who makes Free Scripture, how stories are written and reviewed, and the text sources and licenses.
- [Sitemap](https://freescripture.org/sitemap.xml)
